summary: This bill increases the minimum medical loss ratio for health insurance in the small group and individual markets from 80% to 85% and establishes civil and criminal penalties for agents and brokers who provide incorrect, false, or fraudulent information when enrolling individuals in health plans through an Exchange.

scores.thoughts: This bill directly amends the Public Health Service Act and the Patient Protection and Affordable Care Act, focusing on increasing medical loss ratios for health insurance and penalizing fraudulent enrollment in qualified health plans. These provisions aim to regulate the health insurance market and ensure more premium dollars are spent on care, which leans towards public oversight of private healthcare. The bill also aims to reduce fraudulent enrollment in qualified health plans, which are part of the ACA, a public program.
